articles.why_l1_cares: The report can provide context for alerts already in the queue and ideas for targeted hunting.

articles.title: Frontline Education breach exposes school district employee data
articles.summary: Frontline Education is notifying school districts of a data breach after attackers exploited a vulnerability in third-party software to gain unauthorized access to its systems and steal employee information, including Social Security numbers.…
articles.why_l1_cares: Breach reporting can reveal exposed credentials, third-party risk or activity relevant to current alerts.
first_checks: Confirm whether your organization, supplier or technology stack is affected.
Monitor for related credential abuse, phishing and data access.
Capture confirmed scope and primary-source statements before escalating.
articles.escalate_when: Escalate on organizational exposure, credential compromise or matching suspicious activity.

articles.title: Microsoft’s X account hacked in crypto pump-and-dump scheme
articles.summary: On Thursday, unknown attackers hijacked the official Microsoft account on X, which has over 13 million followers, in what appeared to be a pump-and-dump scheme promoting a crypto token.…
articles.why_l1_cares: Identity activity often becomes the first visible signal before mailbox, cloud or endpoint impact.
first_checks: Review risky sign-ins, impossible travel and unfamiliar devices.
Check MFA, password and app-consent changes around the event.
Correlate the account with mailbox, endpoint and token activity.
articles.escalate_when: Escalate on successful anomalous sign-in, MFA reset, suspicious consent or token reuse.
